svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Multi-region disaster recovery on Google Cloud
svg.desc: Multi-region disaster recovery on Google Cloud. 7 components in 8 groups. Connections: Users to Cloud Load Balancing (HTTPS); Cloud Load Balancing to Compute Engine (active backend); Cloud Load Balancing to Compute Engine (failover); Compute Engine to Cloud SQL (private IP); Compute Engine to Cloud SQL (zone failover); Cloud SQL to Cloud SQL; Cloud SQL to Cloud SQL; Compute Engine to Cloud SQL (after promotion).

text.tspan: MULTI-REGION DISASTER RECOVERY ON GOOGLE CLOUD
A global load balancer serves us-east1 and fails over to a warm standby in us-west1, whose Cloud SQL replica is promoted
